sources.quote: Rev C, 2026-06-01: material changed from EN AW-6061-T6 to EN AW-6082-T6; yield requirement raised from 240 MPa to 250 MPa; SC-01 introduced.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa

findings.why: The drawing in force is Rev C, which requires EN AW-6082-T6 with yield of at least 250 MPa. The offered 6061-T6 (min 240 MPa) does not meet that grade or yield. Elena's mail cites the superseded Rev B values, so it cannot be relied on.

sources.quote: APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)
BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).

findings.why: Alluminio B's approval for BR-220 (TO1, STL) covers billet grade 6082-T6 only, per PPAP against drawing Rev C. There is no approval for 6061-T6 bar for this part, so the proposed shipment has no current source approval. This assumes TO1 is the receiving plant, because the ASL excludes TO3.

sources.quote: 5. Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: The drawing requires a 3.1 certificate with each lot. No certificate or test result is provided for the proposed 6061-T6 bar lot. A person must confirm that the certificate exists and what Rp0.2 it shows.
